projects.title: AI Virtual Try-On Fashion E-commerce Platform
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a production-ready AI virtual try-on system for fashion e-commerce using state-of-the-art models from **Hugging Face**.
- Implemented human parsing, image segmentation, pose estimation, and virtual garment fitting pipelines.
- Deployed GPU inference services on **AWS**, **Google Cloud Platform**, and **DigitalOcean**.
- Built a responsive frontend using **Next.js**, **React**, and **Tailwind CSS**.

projects.title: DEEP_RESEARCH_GEN_AI
projects.bodyText:
- Built an autonomous AI research assistant using **LangChain**, **Mistral AI**, and **Tavily Search**.
- Implemented intelligent planning, web search, document analysis, summarization, and report generation.
- Developed an interactive **Streamlit** interface for AI-assisted research.
- Automated multi-step research workflows using multiple AI agents.

projects.title: TUITION_MEDIA
projects.bodyText:
- Built a comprehensive tuition management platform connecting teachers, students, and guardians.
- Implemented a secure marketplace where Guardians can **post tuition opportunities** and Teachers can **apply for available tuition**.
- Integrated **Guardian-Teacher Management tools** for seamless background verification, profile approvals, and onboarding.
- Developed an automated **Demo Schedule system** allowing guardians to book and track trial classes with prospective tutors.
- Built a central **Admin Dashboard** with overarching metrics to oversee match-making pipelines, resolve disputes, and manage users.
- Incorporated a reliable **Payment Gateway** to process handle platform commissions, and automate tutor payouts.

projects.title: ED_TECH_PROJECT
projects.bodyText:
- Built a full-stack **EdTech course-selling platform** connecting Students and Instructors.
- Developed a **Course Marketplace** for course creation, publishing, browsing, purchasing, and enrollment.
- Implemented **Learning Management** with lesson access and progress tracking.
- Created **Student, Instructor, and Admin Dashboards** for managing courses, users, content, and transactions.
- Integrated a secure **Payment Gateway** with platform commissions and instructor payouts.
- Implemented **role-based authentication and authorization** with a responsive user interface.

projects.title: Dhaka Metro Rail Management System
projects.bodyText:
- Designed and implemented a comprehensive Metro Rail Management System using **MySQL**.
- Developed normalized relational database schemas for trains, stations, routes, schedules, passengers, and ticket management.
- Implemented SQL queries, stored procedures, triggers, views, and constraints.
- Optimized database performance through indexing and efficient query design.
